info.name: Xeno
info.description: Organized collection for Xeno integrators. User APIs cover OpenAI-compatible and Ollama-compatible inference, Xeno Client covers the local dashboard API, and Xeno Server covers management and operations APIs.

item.name: User APIs
Ollama APIs
item.description: Ollama-compatible application APIs. Uses collection Bearer Token auth; bearer credentials infer tenant context.
OpenAI-compatible and Ollama-compatible application APIs. Uses collection Bearer Token auth; bearer credentials infer tenant context.

item.name: Xeno Client
item.description: Local dashboard and client management APIs exposed by a running Xeno Client.

item.name: Xeno Server
Model Token Leaderboard
item.description: Public unauthenticated model token leaderboard with request counts. Omit tenantId for global statistics. limit and offset are optional numeric fields; omit them or send null for defaults.

request.description: No authentication headers; expected 401 when authentication is required.
